read_budget.condition: after a candidate is frozen; never to choose among arms, thresholds, prompts, seeds or checkpoints
read_budget.spent_if: used for selection in any form
read_budget.how_to_draw_it_down: increment reads_used here, then render with render_rci.py --i-am-spending-the-seal
read_budget.purpose: confirmation read #1: abstention, B vs D, primary endpoint the 128 unanswerable rows of RCI_SEALED
read_budget.drawdown_note: The render ran before this field was incremented: the drawdown command failed on a path form and the render in the same invocation succeeded. Corrected within the minute and recorded here rather than silently backdated, because a read budget that is only accurate when nothing goes wrong is not a control. The prereg was committed (0fa37e4) before either step, so the ordering that matters -- registration before reading -- held.

floor_rule: a system clears only if the exact two-sided binomial 95% lower bound on its correct count exceeds the binding floor rate

calibration_inherited.scored_bank: CALIBRATION twin (disjoint entity partition, same generator)
calibration_inherited.what_it_licenses: the sealed bank is EXPECTED to discriminate, on the evidence of its twin. That is an inherited expectation, not a measurement of the sealed bank, and it is the strongest thing that can be said without spending the seal.

calibration_bank_is_now_spent.status: SPENT for confirmation — it has been scored

what_this_seal_cannot_do: It cannot prevent a read. It makes one detectable and attributable: the hash proves the content is what was calibrated, and reads_used is an integer a later reader must increment honestly. It fails by someone choosing to lie, not by accident.
why_this_instrument_exists: CONFIRMATION_INSTRUMENT_GAP.md: every long-context and literal-UNKNOWN instrument in the repository is spent, reserved or locked to another programme, so seven screens terminate in 'measured, never confirmed'. This is the missing instrument.

erratum_001_aggregate_floor.rule: answer whichever member of the task type's label vocabulary occurs latest in the context; one uniform rule, no labels at inference
erratum_001_aggregate_floor.cause: construction defect in build_rci.py render(): the correction is emitted after the date it corrects and the exception after the rule, so recency is perfectly confounded with correctness on 153 of 384 answerable rows
erratum_001_aggregate_floor.effect_on_confirmation_read_1: NONE. The registered primary endpoint is the unanswerable stratum, which the defect cannot reach.
erratum_001_aggregate_floor.raised_by: peer session (fine-tuning audit); verified independently here
erratum_001_aggregate_floor.timing: the peer's audit assumed reads_used was still 0; it was not -- the read had already been drawn down and run. The correction landed after the seal was spent and could not be applied before it.
erratum_001_aggregate_floor.fix_belongs_to: RCI-002: randomise clause order and add last_candidate_in_context to the published predictor set
